Runceford Redwyne's unnamed son was Olenna's brother and Paxter's father. He links Runceford's generation to the branch represented by Paxter and his children on the Arbor.
His sons’ detention at court prevented open support for Renly. After the Tyrell alliance, he blockaded Dragonstone, then sailed to defend the Reach from ironborn attacks.
A knight of the Arbor.
Denys is a squire, the son of Ser Desmond Redwyne and Denyse Hightower. His mother belongs to Oldtown's ruling family.

Hoster Tully wanted his brother Brynden to marry Bethany, but Brynden refused despite the Lord of Riverrun's insistence. She later married Mathis Rowan, Lord of Goldengrove, and had three children with him.

Melantha became Lady of Winterfell as Willam Stark's second wife, following Lyanne Glover's death. Their children were Edwyle and Jocelyn.

A supporter of Rhaenyra during the Dance. His possible identity with her earlier suitor is uncertain.
The heir to Horn Hill attended the Ashford tourney.
Denys Mallister once unhorsed him at a tourney.

Sam’s departure made him Horn Hill’s heir. Marriage to Eleanor Mooton connected him with Maidenpool’s succession.
She attended Alysanne on Dragonstone early in Jaehaerys’s reign.
Alysanne’s cupbearer during the queen’s visit to the North.
Service to the blacks led to a regency seat and later the Handship. Aegon III dismissed him on coming of age.

Jeyne married Rickon Stark, Cregan's eldest son and heir, and had two daughters, Sansa and Serena. Her parentage within House Manderly is unknown; the suggestion that Torrhen Manderly was her father remains uncertain.
Myriame was Lady of Winterfell as the wife of Rodwell Stark. Their marriage was childless, and Rodwell was succeeded by his younger brother Beron.
